title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-03-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard captures a stellar 1970 performance highlighted by a soaring Cryptical reprise and vivid Uncle John’s Band.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about this show, calling it the "real deal" with a very strong set that shines on the Cryptical Envelopment reprise and an unmistakably crisp Uncle John’s Band. The soundboard source is praised as crystal‑clear, making every instrument—from guitars to the hinted‑at banjo/mandolin—stand out beautifully.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer stars (4–5) and unanimous praise for both performance and soundboard quality drive a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as crystal‑clear, with excellent instrument separation (even hearing banjo/mandolin tones) and no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, flowing performance that maintains high energy throughout; reviewers note the show feels cohesive and engaging.
